jobs.description:
Desay SV Automotive Europe GmbH, the European headquarters of Desay SV Automotive, is located in Weimar, Germany. As a technology specialist for advanced hardware, software, and connectivity, we play a key role in transferring Desay SV’s global innovation strength into tailored solutions for the European automotive market. Our corporate culture is characterized by dynamism, diversity, openness and fairness.

Desay SV Europe is part of Huizhou Desay SV Automotive Co., Ltd. based in China, a leading, stock exchange-listed provider of mobility solutions in the fields of Smart Cabin, Smart Drive and Smart Service. As a top 100 supplier and with its high level of technology expertise, Desay SV supports car manufacturers worldwide in their mobility transformation, making driving safer, more comfortable and more efficient.

We are looking for Senior System Architecture Engineer (m/f/d) in France

Your tasks

- As the onsite technical interface to customers, system architecture engineer shall lead technical proposal of project quotation, including requirement analysis and system design proposal.
- Responsible for system solution proposal, including:
1. Study RFI/RFQ documents from customer, analyze and clarify customer's requirement,
2. Leading/support System Concept Design proposal, coordinate R&D and output complete system solutions
3. Onsite TA (Technical Addendum) presentation and concern clarification,
4. Follow up questions raised by customers on technology assessment, and provide quick and professional service to customers, support them for the feasibility evaluation.
- Responsible for the product technology planning of strategic customers
- Act as an on-site technical window to customer for development project to support technical feasibility evaluation and explanation.

Your profile

- Many years of experience as system engineer in the automotive industry, ideally in the supplier industry in Europe,
- Well experienced of providing technical solution during quotation phase.
- Knowledge of the cockpit or ADAS domain controller
- Familiarity with current trends and technologies in the field of smart cockpit and autonomous driving
- Ability to analyze, summarize, coordinate and organize, define and refinerequirements.
- Ability to work in a team and collaborate effectively with stakeholders.
- Customer and solution-oriented thinking
- Excellent communication skills in English (is a must) and German (is a plus), Exceptional presentation and written skills (PowerPoint)
- Bachelor’s or master’s degree in systems engineering, electrical engineering, computer science or a related field
- Energetic, passionate, curiousness, open-minded, resilient, and self-drive
- Willingness to travel (1-2 times per month)

We offer

- Training and continuing education
- Individual training
- Company cell phone
- Company laptop
- 30 Vacation days per year
- Company car
- Parking lot
- Flexible working hours
- Mobile working
- Good traffic connections
- Employee bonuses
- Employee events
- Friendly and trustful colleagues
- Accident insurance (private and professional)

We look forward to receiving your application.

At Miele, we are committed to talent, growth and sustainability. A permanent contract.

About the position

As part of the global modernization of its infrastructure, our client is migrating its workloads currently hosted on end-of-life physical RKE servers in China to managed services from a Chinese cloud provider. This strategic project, estimated to last 12 months, aims to design a modern, automated, and highly available target architecture.

Contrat : Project-based permanent contract (CDI) or Freelance contract, project with an initial duration of one year (completion scheduled for summer 2027).

Location : Montbéliard area, an on-site presence of at least 2 days/week will be required for the first 2 or 3 weeks during the scoping phase.

Your responsibilities:

Reporting to the IT department's technical team, your responsibilities will be as follows:

Scoping and Estimation: Conduct the technical feasibility study, define the target architecture, and present the detailed estimation to the CIO in September.

Architecture Build: Design and build the infrastructure on a Chinese cloud provider (such as Alibaba Cloud), focusing on managed services.

Automation & Deployment: Replicate the existing automation mechanisms on GCP using Terraform and deploy the new clusters via Helm.

Friction Point Resolution: Design network architectures (SD-WAN, cross-border line) to maintain API connectivity with Google, manage authentication interoperability (Google Identity), and define security policies equivalent to Cloud Armor.

Profile sought

Experience : Proven and mandatory track record on a Chinese cloud provider (ideally Alibaba Cloud). We are looking for a profile with at least 5 years of experience as a Senior Cloud Consultant or Cloud Architect, who has already participated in scoping and estimation phases.

Technical Skills

Mastery of the managed Kubernetes ecosystem, managed databases, and object storage.

Expertise in Terraform and Helm.

Strong skills in international network architecture and cross-border connectivity.

GCP skills.

Knowledge of security solutions (WAF/Cloud Armor) and identity management (SSO/Google Cloud Identity).

Daily use of AI.

Soft Skills :

Analytical mindset and pragmatism to design solutions that are simple to operate daily.

Autonomy and proactive approach to guide the client in their strategic choices (e.g., alternatives to PubSub).

Ability to communicate easily with cross-functional teams.

Languages : Fluent English (international context), French or Mandarin would be a major asset.

Recruitment process :

- Initial interview with our recruiter and the head of the structure, who is an IT engineer.
- Presentation of your application to our client (following mutual agreement).
- Meeting with the client and their teams to discuss the position and expectations.

Would you like to know more? We invite you to apply and/or contact us!

Job Description: 

Airbus Commercial Aircraft is looking for an Engineer in Certification and airworthiness (f/m) to join our Design and Repair certification department based in Toulouse, France.

You will be part of a team providing airworthiness approval to In-Service repair solutions . As part of the Certification team , you will be involved with Customer Care Center matters to give the best repair solution to the customers for them to bring back their aircraft in an airworthy condition after an event. 

Your working environment:

Global capital of aeronautics and European capital for space research, Toulouse is a dynamic city in the southwest of France served by an international airport. Ideally located between the Mediterranean sea and the Atlantic ocean and close to the Pyrenees mountains, it offers plenty of options for outdoor activities! 

How we care for you:

Financial rewards: Attractive salary, agreements on success and profit sharing schemes, employee savings plan abounded by Airbus and employee stock purchase plan on a voluntary basis. 
Work / Life Balance:   Extra days-off for special occasions, holiday transfer option, a Staff council offering many social, cultural and sport activities and other services. 
Wellbeing / Health: Complementary health insurance coverage (disability, invalidity, death). Depending on the site: health services center, concierge services, gym, carpooling application. 
Individual development: Great upskilling opportunities and development prospects  with unlimited access to +10.000 e-learning courses to develop your employability, certifications, expert career path, accelerated development programmes, national and international mobility. 

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly.    

 Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking. 

Your challenges:

We are in close collaboration with all Airbus design offices worldwide. 

 We are working together with two other off-shore teams, in a follow the sun approach : 
 one based in Mobile (USA) 
 one based in Bangalore (India) 

The work will be performed 7 days a week (monday to sunday) in shifts on day time hours by rotation. 

 Your main tasks and responsibilities are: 

Provide Airworthiness approval of in-service repair solutions supported by the Repair and Design Approval Form (RDAF), and Flight Condition Documents (FCD).  

 Interface with Airbus customer services, design offices, chief engineer teams and the other airworthiness departments.  

 Act on request as airworthiness specialists in a multifunctional team to solve Aircraft on Ground situations (AOG). 

 This position is an opportunity to work for all Airbus civil programs, on all ATA chapters and develop multi-skills. 

 Being part of a very dynamic team, you will acquire a high level of overall aircraft knowledge, and enlarge your network within the company. 

After the initial training period, the work will be performed seven days a week (Monday to Sunday) in shifts on daytime hours by rotation. 

Your boarding pass:

You have an advanced level in English. 

 You are educated to degree level (or equivalent) in Engineering or a related discipline. 

You have structure and systems skills. 

 You have a good general knowledge in aeronautics. 

 You have experience in the design office and/or in airworthiness. Knowledge in configuration management is a plus. 

 You are a real collaborative team player, reactive and curious. 

This position requires a security clearance or will require being eligible for clearance by the recognized authorities. 

 Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions. 

 Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

Job Description:

The Lead Data Architect will lead the enterprise viewpoint for how data assets should be structured and used to deliver prioritized business outcomes, translating business strategy into data and analytics architecture and implementation guidance.

 You will be responsible for the following main activities: 
 Provide the technical roadmap and scalable architecture needed to translate the Airbus Helicopters Data Strategy to action, ensuring the foundation is reliable and AI-ready. 
 Define and enforce a unified catalog of approved technologies (bricks) to promote standardization and prevent architectural fragmentation. 
 Coordinate the D&A architecture community of practice and provide oversight of solution architecture, data architecture and data engineering to ensure consensus on definitive models and platforms. 
 Ensure that the architectural roadmap is aligned with the Enterprise Architecture's corporate strategy and risk mandates.

Ability to quickly comprehend the functions and capabilities of new technologies.
Advanced level of English.

 3 Reasons to join us:

Inclusion and diversity : We foster an inclusive and rewarding work environment, where everyone's diversity is valued and respected. An inclusive and diverse workforce is the engine of innovation at Airbus. It makes us unique and contributes to better problem-solving.

A dynamic CSE (Social and Economic Committee) offering many advantages (company restaurant, children's leisure center, associations and sports complex, travel allowances,

VACANCY

The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to carry out world-class research. Are you interested in joining our international institute? We currently have a vacancy for an:

Assistant Buyer (M/F)

Duties:
Be a part of one of our Institute's key missions by joining our Purchasing Service, which is responsible for purchases and contracts with an overall value representing almost half of the ILL's annual budget (of around ?100 million).

As assistant buyer, you will take charge of the following administrative duties:
- Provide our buyers with administrative support by helping them with the following: sending out of invitations to attend meetings, preparation of meetings and drafting of minutes (meetings of internal Purchasing Commission and Purchasing Advisors, meetings with sales representatives, suppliers, etc.)
- Enter, modify and send out orders to suppliers after they have been recorded in our ERP
- Manage the administrative part of the Invitation to Tender process: sending out of invitations to tender, follow-up, summarising and statistical monitoring
- Process orders with a value of less than 5 000 euros, as well as bank card orders
- Monitor dashboards and report regularly to the Head of Service
- Act as contact point for users, buyers and the ILL stores
- Maintain the Purchasing Service's intranet pages
- Manage the purchasing month-end closing process
- Fill in for the secretary of the Purchasing Service when absent with the preparation of minutes of Service meetings, management of office supplies and dealing with the mail.

Qualifications and experience:
- NVQ Level 4 in Business and Administration (or equivalent qualification) specialising in purchasing or international commerce with some initial experience of purchasing or commerce in industry or in the research sector, ideally with an international focus.
- Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office and a firm understanding of an SAP/ORACLE-type ERP application.

As a contact person who communicates information on the ILL's purchasing policy, you combine interpersonal and analytical skills with a meticulous approach to your work. Your ability to manage priorities is an essential asset for this post, which requires efficiency and a proactive attitude.

Language skills:
As an international research centre, we are particularly keen to ensure that we also attract applicants from outside France. You must have a sound knowledge of English and be willing to learn French (a language course will be paid for by the ILL). Knowledge of German would be an advantage.
Benefits: Generous company benefits (expatriation allowance), relocation assistance and language courses may be offered (for more information, please consult our employment conditions).
